name: workflow_complete_step
description: Commit a step's output to the run's ctx and advance the cursor to the next step in tree order. Call this after workflow_run_step once the orchestrator is satisfied with the result. The output value is stored under the step's declared output name (e.g. ctx.plan, ctx.build) and becomes available to subsequent $ctx.* references. If the step has no declared output, pass an empty object. Returns the refreshed run state.

stepId.description: The step being completed. Must match the step most recently run, or an explicitly named completed step.

output.description: The step's output value to commit to ctx under the step's declared output name.

note.description: Optional short note describing why this output was accepted. Recorded in run history for audit.
